sn12.92:1.2: One who does not truly know or see the origin of choices should seek the Teacher so as to truly know the origin of choices;
sn12.92:1.3: One who does not truly know or see the cessation of choices should seek the Teacher so as to truly know the cessation of choices;
sn12.92:1.4: One who does not truly know or see the practice that leads to the cessation of choices should seek the Teacher so as to truly know the practice that leads to the cessation of choices.”
